messages:
Lena T.: Heads-up: Prospect (Careline) asked for a POC evidence bundle + signed pen-test attestation and wants to know if Dedicated pricing applies for a 10-day trial. Need plan.
Marco D.: Do they require VPC/private or will hosted suffice? That affects what we can share and lead time.
Lena T.: Discovery notes: they prefer hosted but compliance team hinted they might prefer dedicated if throughput/SLA looks better. Target = 10 business days, ~30k tokens/day.
Marco D.: I'll draft a lean proofpack list: redacted SOC2 excerpt, ISO27001 cert, pen-test attestation template, high-level network diagram, KMS/keyflow, logging retention table, data residency note.
Hannah (Legal): We require an NDA before sharing unredacted reports. Our pen-test attestation template is fine for signature; if they ask for the vendor report we can only provide an attestation unless vendor permits redistribution. Redaction guidance must be explicit.
Lena T.: Customer contact: ops@careline.health. They prefer presigned S3 or SFTP.
OpsBot: Evidence bucket created: s3://rw-evidence-careline-1747551234 16 presigned uploads enabled 72h (owner: marco.d).
Marco D.: I'll upload a draft and include a small readme with which docs require NDA and suggested redactions.
Lena T.: Pricing note: hosted = pay-as-you-go usage; Dedicated = reserved monthly commit (not ideal for a short POC). Offer hosted POC + short Dedicated demo/burst to showcase throughput without a full month commit.
Hannah (Legal): I'll review the attestation wording before send. If they request vendor signatory include vendor contact.
Marco D.: Draft uploaded: evidence/readme.txt, evidence/soc2-redacted.pdf, evidence/iso27001.pdf, evidence/pen-test-attestation-template.pdf. Link in bucket.
Lena T.: I'll confirm on tomorrow's call whether "on-prem" is a hard requirement. If so, loop Eng-platform & Security 12 timeline will extend.
Marco D.: Action: post hosted vs dedicated cost comparison by EOD in thread.
Lena T.: Target: if hosted accepted, aim to send signed attestation + evidence ZIP within 48-72h after call.
